summary: Semi tractor-trailer carrying chicken feed driven by Raul Marquez of West Palm Beach, FL plunged off the Wolf Creek Pass overlook ~4:30 a.m.; Marquez was killed. Evidence suggested a second occupant (clothes, IDs, another driver reporting a passenger) who was never found despite a search dog lowered 300 ft to the wreckage; the case was turned over to the FBI.
location: Wolf Creek Pass overlook, U.S. Highway 160
responding_agency: Mineral County Sheriff's Office / Colorado State Patrol
notes: MERGE note run970: crash+SAR-search hybrid — search-dog deployment for the possible second occupant; DGO feature cites Pagosa SUN (driver death) and Mineral County Miner reporting. Victims=1 for the driver; the possible second occupant was never found and remains unconfirmed.
